title: Preserve authored track short names
scope: Retain GPIF ShortName independently from the full track name through parsing and GP8 export.
acceptance: Use different full and short names on two tracks and verify exact identities through the public API.
Cover empty, Unicode and XML-sensitive short names without automatic truncation.
The pinned consumer sees the exact short name after a public edit and export.

reproduction.instructions: Reproduce via the public Go parser and GP8 exporter, then load original and output with pinned AlphaTab. The observed end-to-end difference alone does not locate the failing stage. Focused regression: ALPHATAB_CONFORMANCE=1 go test ./... -run "^(TestSectionAndTrackNames|TestSectionTitlePublicEdits|TestShortNamePublicPresenceAndPolicy|TestConformanceSectionTrackNames|TestAlphaTabSectionTrackNames)$". The original synthetic fixture and canonical receipt are committed; full probe refresh remains part of root integration.

evidence.detail: Reproduced at tracks[0].shortName. Source and target values are stored in probe_comparison.
Exact field/wire/runtime claims, nonmutation, occurrence ownership, legacy authority and consumer-loss policy.
Exact raw and final pinned-consumer values are independently asserted; final empty-name derivation is an explicit limit.
Hash-bound synthetic source and exact exported source/edit/empty/whitespace consumer facts and reports.
Independent agent acceptance review for issue 91; preserved current criteria, exact source commits, commands and scoped residual failures.

resolution: Implemented optional Track.ShortName with independent occurrence-owned storage: nil means absent and non-nil empty preserves authored empty. Public edits and exact GP8 text never truncate or replace the full name. Final AlphaTab preserves nonempty Unicode/XML-sensitive values; its empty-name derivation and boundary-whitespace behavior with CDATA terminators or carriage returns have scoped export reports and strict-policy tests. Fresh independent acceptance review, integrated full gates and the refreshed370-fixture probe passed. The issue remains open with the solved label for subsequent verification. Fresh independent agent review passed the current bounded acceptance criteria. The issue remains OPEN with a solved label for later disposition.
